response.what_it_is: Butterfly manual treadle sewing machine with wooden table and cast-iron base
visible_condition: wooden table surface shows scuffs and wear
cast-iron treadle base and machine head appear structurally intact
hidden_risks: internal mechanical wear and timing issues
missing internal components like the shuttle or bobbin case
condition and elasticity of the treadle drive belt
response.failure_mode: Mistaking a traditional manual treadle sewing machine for an industrial electric sewing machine, or overvaluing based on external appearance without checking internal mechanical condition.
